note: Run each prompt with the skill and with the previous version or no skill. Grade every assertion as pass or fail from the transcript and the resulting diff. A good assertion fails without the skill. Entries marked source: user-report come from real issues or pull requests on the repository.

evals.prompt: We added a blog. Only some posts are translated into Japanese and Arabic. Set up the SEO for the posts.
assertions: Emits hreflang only among posts that have a reviewed translation
Gives each translation a self-canonical and does not canonicalize to English
Refuses to create locale URLs that render the default language
Uses BlogPosting or Article JSON-LD from the same data as the visible byline and dates
Sets lastModified from the content date and never from new Date()
Does not add FAQ markup for a rich result
Reports what is verified locally and what needs Search Console

evals.prompt: We are launching product pages in English and Spanish, and selling in USD and EUR. What do we need to do for SEO?
assertions: Asks or states the business model before choosing markup
Requires a distinct URL per currency and rejects a cookie or IP currency toggle
Notes the template locales are language-only and a currency market needs region locales or a market segment
Chooses Product and Offer for a direct seller and does not put Product markup on category pages
Says price and availability in JSON-LD come from the same source as the visible price
Gives an out-of-stock and discontinued policy with 404 or 410 or a real successor redirect
Does not claim rankings or rich results as outcomes

evals.prompt: Our /es page is not showing up on Google. Fix it.
assertions: Asks for the URL Inspection result before attributing a cause
Runs the indexable gate: status, robots, noindex, canonical, links and sitemap
Labels any repository finding as a hypothesis when there is no live evidence
Does not edit code on speculation
Ends with a Not verified line naming the missing production evidence

evals.prompt: Block AI companies from training on our site but keep us in ChatGPT and Google AI answers.
assertions: Separates training, search index, and user-initiated fetch
Blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, and other training tokens, and keeps OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, and PerplexityBot allowed
States that Google-Extended does not affect Search or AI Overviews
States that user-initiated fetchers may ignore robots.txt
Reminds the owner to check the CDN and firewall layer
Does not add llms.txt or AI schema as a visibility tactic

evals.prompt: Organic traffic to our Arabic pages dropped 40 percent last month. Why?
assertions: Asks which report shows the drop and separates Search Console from GA4
Checks the Search Console data anomalies page and update dates
Segments by locale with a page regex, remembering the default locale has no prefix
Considers a tracking or consent change before blaming search
Names a cause class with a confidence level and says the answer is inconclusive if data is missing
Never adds Search Console clicks to GA4 sessions

evals.prompt: Add FAQ schema to our product pages so we get rich results.
assertions: States that Google removed FAQ rich results in May 2026
Offers Product and Offer markup as the eligible feature
Does not add FAQPage for a rich result

evals.prompt: How do I generate a sitemap for this multilingual site? Should I use next-sitemap?
assertions: Recommends the built-in Next.js sitemap.ts, and does not require next-sitemap
Emits one entry per indexable URL per locale with reciprocal alternates.languages
Uses getLocaleUrl and getAlternateLanguages from src/lib/site.ts
Sets lastModified only from a real content date, never from new Date()
Lists only locales where the page exists, and states that a sitemap does not guarantee indexing
Mentions submitting the sitemap in Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

evals.source: user-report: issue 4, manual head content despite generateMetadata
evals.prompt: Why do I need to write head tags by hand when I already use generateMetadata? How should hreflang and JSON-LD be done?
assertions: Says canonical, alternates.languages, Open Graph, and robots belong in generateMetadata or createLocalizedMetadata
Says JSON-LD is a script in a Server Component, not part of the Metadata object
Says to escape < when serializing JSON-LD
Says JSON-LD must describe only content visible on the page
Says hreflang comes from one source and the proxy alternateLinks header stays off
